[[File:Machito Gomi.png|200px|thumb|right|Gomi's avatarFrom {{vol|Pokémon Journeys|1}} of {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}}]] '''Machito Gomi''' (Japanese: '''五味まちと''' ''Gomi Machito;'' born March 12, 1992) is a mangaka from {{wp|Tokyo}} and artist for the Pokémon series, beginning with his manga adaptation of [[M22]], {{ma|Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution}}. ==Artwork== This is a collection of official Pokémon artwork drawn by Gomi. ===Other games=== This is a collection of other Pokémon games that Gomi has contributed artwork to.
